AssessmentBrief.title: AssessmentBrief
AssessmentBrief.description: One brief of an assessment. None is current: every brief is listed.

AssessmentDetailResponse.title: AssessmentDetailResponse
AssessmentDetailResponse.description: An assessment with its satisfied rules, signals, positions by ordinal and every brief.

AssessmentListItem.title: AssessmentListItem
AssessmentListItem.description: An assessment and the ids of every brief generated for it.

AssessmentListResponse.title: AssessmentListResponse
AssessmentListResponse.description:
One limit/offset page: newest as_of first, then by scope and versions, then by
ranking key, then by id.

AssessmentPosition.title: AssessmentPosition
AssessmentPosition.description: One position a function stated, as stored, with its evidence.

AssessmentRunItem.title: AssessmentRunItem
AssessmentRunItem.description: One customer's result: its assessment, whether this run created it, and its brief.

AssessmentRunRequest.title: AssessmentRunRequest
AssessmentRunRequest.description:
Assess every customer in scope, or the one named, and persist the results.

as_of is required and may be null, which asks for the scope's fallback
date explicitly. The run is unpinned: no expected fingerprint is taken,
and no rules, linker or policy override is accepted.

AssessmentRunResponse.title: AssessmentRunResponse
AssessmentRunResponse.description: One item per customer assessed, in ranking order.

BriefResponse.title: BriefResponse
BriefResponse.description:
A stored brief, read back as written: nothing is re-rendered or re-resolved.

status is the stored column and is never updated; decision_status is
derived from the brief's decision history. payload is the stored decision
payload as an opaque object, and citations are the payload's own distinct
citations in ascending wire order.

CanonicalRecordCounts.title: CanonicalRecordCounts
CanonicalRecordCounts.description: Canonical records per entity type; every type is always present.

CustomerCanonical.title: CustomerCanonical
CustomerCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of a Customer.

Supports customer/account intelligence. owner_source_id is
a source-system reference to the account owner employee.

DealCanonical.title: DealCanonical
DealCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of a Deal.

customer_id is nullable because unresolved customer references
must be preserved, not rejected. The original customer_source_id
is always preserved for tracking.

DecisionHistoryResponse.title: DecisionHistoryResponse
DecisionHistoryResponse.description: A brief's decisions in chain order, first to head.

DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest
DecisionRequest.description:
Record a human decision on a stored brief.

actor is recorded exactly as supplied; it is asserted, never
authenticated, and never validated as an email address. supersedes_id is
null only for the brief's first decision, and otherwise names its current
head.

DocumentCanonical.title: DocumentCanonical
DocumentCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of a Document.

Supports future RAG and institutional memory. body_text
accepts full textual content with no artificial length limit.

DurationSummary.title: DurationSummary
DurationSummary.description: Finished runs (count) and their summed duration in seconds (sum).

EmployeeCanonical.title: EmployeeCanonical
EmployeeCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of an Employee.

Supports HR and ownership relationships. manager_source_id
is a source-system reference (not a canonical UUID) because
the manager may come from any source system.

EntityRunResult.title: EntityRunResult
EntityRunResult.description: One entity's outcome. failure is an exception class name or error code.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: Canonical entity types, in dependency order.

ErrorFinding.title: ErrorFinding
ErrorFinding.description: A field-level finding. Source values are never included.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every API error response.

ErrorSeverityCounts.title: ErrorSeverityCounts
ErrorSeverityCounts.description: ingestion_errors rows per severity; every severity is always present.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Liveness (the process answered) and readiness (its dependencies are reachable).

IngestionErrorResponse.title: IngestionErrorResponse
IngestionErrorResponse.description: A structured ingestion error with a safe message (no raw records or values).

IngestionMetrics.title: IngestionMetrics
IngestionMetrics.description:
Operational ingestion metrics derived from persisted runs, errors and records.

records_failed_total = records_fetched_total - (records_inserted_total
+ records_updated_total + records_unchanged_total + records_rejected_total).
batches_failed_total counts BATCH_FAILED errors; connector_request_failures_total
counts CONNECTOR_UNHEALTHY and CONNECTOR_FAILED errors; validation_errors_total
counts ERROR findings other than those E1 system codes.
ingestion_duration_seconds_total sums finished_at - started_at over finished runs.

IngestionMetricsResponse.title: IngestionMetricsResponse
IngestionMetricsResponse.description:
Database-derived metrics for every source system combined and per source system
(sorted by name), plus the in-process counters of the API process answering.

IngestionRunCreatedResponse.title: IngestionRunCreatedResponse
IngestionRunCreatedResponse.description: The completed run, plus the per-entity results known only at execution time.

IngestionRunRequest.title: IngestionRunRequest
IngestionRunRequest.description:
Start a synchronous ingestion run.

Connection details (URLs, directories, credentials) cannot be supplied:
the source is built from its committed configuration. entities omitted
means every entity the source provides; parents always run first.
dry_run is accepted for contract compatibility, but only false is
supported.

IngestionRunResponse.title: IngestionRunResponse
IngestionRunResponse.description:
A run's state and quality counts.

records_fetched = records_inserted + records_updated + records_unchanged
+ records_rejected + records_failed. records_raw_persisted counts captured
source_records rows; batches_failed counts rolled-back batches.

OrganizationCanonical.title: OrganizationCanonical
OrganizationCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of an Organization.

Represents the enterprise boundary / tenant. The demo system
has one organization (e.g. "Acme Corp").

ProcessIngestionMetrics.title: ProcessIngestionMetrics
ProcessIngestionMetrics.description:
Counters for ingestion runs executed by this API process since started_at.

They start at zero when the process starts and are not persisted; runs of
other processes (other API workers, the ingest-demo command) are not
included. runs_by_status RUNNING counts runs still in progress. Record
counts come from committed batches (a failed batch's records count as
fetched); every rejected record is one validation error;
connector_request_failures_total counts failed health checks and failed
page fetches; ingestion_duration_seconds covers finished runs.

ProjectCanonical.title: ProjectCanonical
ProjectCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of a Project.

Supports delivery/resource context. customer_id is nullable
because the customer reference may not resolve.

RiskBand.title: RiskBand
RiskBand.description: Ordinal risk band (plan A5). Never a percentage, never a probability.

RiskDecision.title: RiskDecision
RiskDecision.description: What a decision says about a brief. Mirrors app.decisions.approval.Decision.

RiskDecisionStatus.title: RiskDecisionStatus
RiskDecisionStatus.description: A brief's derived decision state. Mirrors app.decisions.approval.DecisionStatus.

RunStatusCounts.title: RunStatusCounts
RunStatusCounts.description: Runs per status; every status is always present.

SourceHealthResponse.title: SourceHealthResponse
SourceHealthResponse.description:
Connector health. Connector diagnostic messages are never exposed.

error_type is the connector exception class when the check raised.

SourceIngestionMetrics.title: SourceIngestionMetrics
SourceIngestionMetrics.description:
One source system's metrics. last_successful_run is the newest SUCCESS,
PARTIAL_SUCCESS or NOOP run.

SourceSummary.title: SourceSummary
SourceSummary.description: A configured source. Connection details (URLs, paths, credentials) are never exposed.

SupportTicketCanonical.title: SupportTicketCanonical
SupportTicketCanonical.description:
Source-neutral canonical representation of a Support Ticket.

Supports risk/support signal analysis. No is_active field.
